title: Little Bosses Everywhere
description: A “gripping” (The Washington Post) work of history and reportage that unveils the stranger-than-fiction world of multilevel marketing: a massive money-making scam and radical political conspiracy that has remade American society.Reads like a thriller… masterfully illuminates the tricks and sleights of hand that in multilevel marketing are simply the rules of doing business. - The New York Times Book Review (Editor...
